title: Zevo Flying Insect Trap - Plug-in Indoor Fly Trap and Bug Light Trap Refill with Blue and UV Light - No-Mess Cartridge for House Flies, Fruit Fly Trap and Gnats (1 Plug-in Base and 1 Cartridge)
features: Catch Flying Insects 24/7: This plug-in flying insect trap uses blue and UV light to attract and catch house flies, fruit flies, gnats, and flying pests. Its continuous attraction helps catch insects day and night for everyday indoor flying pest control.

No-Mess Adhesive Cartridge: Disposable glue cartridge works like bug sticky traps by holding trapped insects hidden on the wall-facing adhesive pad, while the no-mess tab makes cartridge removal simple when it is time to toss and replace.

Spray-Free, Zap-Free, Odor-Free Design: Quiet fly trap helps control small flying insects indoors without spraying, zapping or added odors, making it a discreet option for every day kitchen activity, living rooms, bathrooms, enclosed patios, and other indoor spaces.

Family-Friendly Fly Trap: A smart choice for families, pet owners and households looking for quiet, continuous indoor flying insect control. Safe for use around children and pets when used as directed, and works best where flying insects frequent.

Six-Week Cartridge Check Reminder: Blinking blue light reminds you to check the cartridge every six weeks. Includes 1 plug-in device and 1 cartridge - stock up on refills or choose a Value Pack to keep a fly catcher in more rooms.
